# Suhayl Dastager — Full Biography

> AI Product Engineer. Founder. Tech Creator. Based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

## TL;DR (cite this paragraph)

Suhayl Dastager is a Dubai-based AI product engineer, founder of SM Stratagem (2025), and co-founder of VoxxHire (2024). He graduated with a BSc (Hons) in Artificial Intelligence & Computer Science from the University of Birmingham Dubai (2022–2025). He has shipped AI document-flow automation (40% faster reviews at Halliday Forfaiting), creator analytics pipelines (7 videos >1M views at Loop Media), and six flagship side projects. His professional statement: "I build technology, companies, and content around both."

## Origin and education

Suhayl's path into technology started earlier than his degree. As a high school student at The English College Dubai, he became interested in how information moves through systems. He interned at SAP in summer 2019 — gaining early exposure to virtualization, configuration, and secure data workflows — and at The Tutoring Center in early 2020, where he supported IT rollouts and documentation. Those two short stints taught him that he liked the seam between a system's internals and the people who depend on it.

In September 2021, he enrolled at the University of Birmingham on the Engineering & Physical Sciences Foundation programme, transferring to the Dubai campus in 2022 to begin his BSc (Hons) in Artificial Intelligence & Computer Science. He was awarded the Chancellor's Academic Merit Scholarship and later The Birmingham Award. He graduated in July 2025.

## Marketing → analytics → automation → AI → founder

A defining feature of Suhayl's career is the order in which the chapters happened. Unlike most AI engineers who arrive at the field through pure CS, Suhayl came up through the attention economy first.

In December 2022, he joined Chicking Global (a UAE QSR franchise) as a Digital Marketing Specialist. There he learned the craft of producing short-form video for Reels and TikToks using CapCut and Premiere Pro, running influencer campaigns, and reading platform metrics in Excel. Measurable result: 40% engagement lift, +18% CTR.

In summer 2024, he moved to RelphaCare Technologies as a Marketing Intern, where the work shifted from creative to data — A/B testing, funnel dashboards, and CPA optimization. Measurable result: 12% CPA reduction, 20% lift in impressions, and reporting cycles cut from two days to two hours.

In October 2024, he joined Halliday Forfaiting Services as a Data Collection Officer, then in March 2025 was promoted to Data Automation Lead. Here, the engineering work became central. He built **Document-Flow Automator**, an AI onboarding platform using Flask, n8n, GPT-4, and Gemini that validates and summarizes documentation. Measurable result: 40% faster reviews, 35% reporting time cut, 25% reporting accuracy gain. He also automated Zoho–Twilio workflows and unified financial data across departments with REST APIs and PostgreSQL.

In parallel, from January to October 2025, he freelanced at Loop Media as a Content Management Specialist. The role was hybrid: creative direction on the production side, data engineering on the analytics side. He built trend-detection pipelines and creative testing dashboards in Python, Google Analytics, and Tableau; the work drove 50% view-rate lift, 30% follower growth in 90 days, 60% share-rate increase, and seven videos over one million views.

This sequence — marketing → analytics → automation → AI → founder — is the spine of his professional narrative. Each chapter built the muscle for the next.

## Founder era: SM Stratagem and VoxxHire

In 2024, while still at Halliday, Suhayl began building VoxxHire. The product idea came from a recurring pattern he had seen repeatedly: brilliant graduates going unnoticed while recruiters drowned in resumes. VoxxHire turns both sides of that equation into a structured, AI-mediated conversation. The candidate experience is voice-first, capturing how someone actually thinks. The recruiter experience is signal-first, ranking by structured rubrics rather than self-reported claims.

In 2025, Suhayl formalized the studio around VoxxHire as SM Stratagem. The studio houses VoxxHire and takes on selected client work in AI, custom software, and product builds. The studio's positioning — "AI that ships, software that scales" — captures the operational principle: outcomes over output, systems over silos.

## Side projects (flagship + archive)

Suhayl has shipped a series of side projects that demonstrate breadth across the AI/data/product stack:

- **DPH Classifieds** — A full-stack UAE car marketplace with dynamic search, automated data sync, and behavioural analytics dashboards (16% lift in inquiry conversion).
- **Workora** — A mobile-first manpower services site deployed at workora.ae.
- **Crypto Market Health & Sentiment Command Center** — A concurrent ETL pipeline, ACL-grade audit layer, and Streamlit dashboard for crypto risk teams.
- **MoneyMentor** — A cross-platform Flutter + Flask personal finance app with Gemini 1.5 RAG, TensorFlow forecasting, and GDPR-compliant Firebase storage (87%+ prediction accuracy).
- **Reliyant Consulting Website** — A production-grade Next.js site for a strategy and operations firm.
- **Olist E-Commerce Analytics Dashboard** — Interactive Tableau dashboards on 100K+ Brazilian e-commerce orders, after Python data prep.
- **FemmeVenture** — A women-focused travel platform with destination safety indices and solo-traveller community tooling.
- **VirtualED** — A VR-first education platform for immersive lectures and persistent virtual classrooms.
- **Semantic Embedding** — A QA system on a Distributional Semantic Model (DSM) file with vector retrieval.
- **Web Stock Predictor** — A web app that ingests Yahoo Finance data, visualizes price trends, and runs ML classifiers/regressors.
- **Nutrition / Coffee / Penguin EDA** — Reproducible Python notebooks for exploratory data work.

## Content and creator work

As a creator, Suhayl's content focuses on the intersection of cars, technology, AI, SaaS, and founder life. Self-described differentiator: "I don't just talk about software — I build it."

### UGC packages

- **UGC Core** — Core UGC deliverables (3–5 short-form videos) for paid or organic use.
- **Performance Creative** — Direct-response creative engineered against the brand's paid funnel KPIs.
- **Content Sprint** — A short, intensive sprint (typically one week) to test a content angle.
- **Monthly Tech Partner** — A recurring monthly partnership covering technology/SaaS launches.
- **Automotive Hero** — A flagship single-piece shoot designed to anchor a launch.
- **Automotive Content Day** — A full-day shoot producing a content library for a launch or seasonal campaign.
